entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian and I, together with project..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian and I, together with project leads Symon and Lileas, met to discuss how to proceed.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Image is everything, Symon. I agre..."
entries.dialogueText: “Image is everything, Symon. I agree this would bolster the President's reputation.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The day before the grand opening ce..."
entries.dialogueText: The day before the grand opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway, we arrived in Lachaven to begin preparations.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I don't support anything beyond th..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't support anything beyond the opening ceremony. The highway speaks for itself."

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: GameCondition.Turn08_InT_LateOpening = true

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a great victory for my admin..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a great victory for my administration.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'd prefer we just do the opening..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless spectacle.”
entries.menuText: “I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless spectacle.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I agree. I'll hit the road.""
entries.dialogueText: “I agree. I'll hit the road."
entries.menuText: “I agree. I'll hit the road."

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“The people will be satisfied. More..."
entries.dialogueText: “The people will be satisfied. More importantly, so will businesses."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Sounds good. It would display unit..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sounds good. It would display unity and strength if we were all together in the convoy.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Very well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Of course. We'll hold the ceremony..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course. We'll hold the ceremony and open the highway to the public immediately after.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Additionally, a large crowd has be..."
entries.dialogueText: “Additionally, a large crowd has been invited to the ceremony and will be watching the opening speech.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It will be a good opportunity for..."
entries.dialogueText: “It will be a good opportunity for exposure.”
entries.menuText: “It will be a good opportunity for exposure.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Like the good old campaign days.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Like the good old campaign days.”
entries.menuText: “Like the good old campaign days.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Loo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Looking forward to it.”
entries.menuText: “Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Looking forward to it.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Alright then. We have a lot of wor..."
entries.dialogueText: “Alright then. We have a lot of work to do. See you in the morning.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We dispersed to begin our individua..."
entries.dialogueText: We dispersed to begin our individual preparations for the big day.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I gave Lucian the green light and t..."
entries.dialogueText: I gave Lucian the green light and the opening address began.
entries.menuText: Signal for Lucian to begin the ceremony.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: BaseGameIsolated.Turn06_InT_Show = true

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The next morning, a stage had been..."
entries.dialogueText: The next morning, a stage had been erected next to the entrance of the highway in downtown Lachaven.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Brothers and sisters of Sordland!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Brothers and sisters of Sordland!”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Thank you, Mr. President. Lachaven..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Mr. President. Lachaven! It is great to be here today among you industrious people.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Thanks, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thanks, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We took our places onstage."
entries.dialogueText: We took our places onstage.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“People of Sordland! Welcome to the..."
entries.dialogueText: “People of Sordland! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”
entries.menuText: “People of Sordland! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian's voice echoed in the square..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian's voice echoed in the square next to the highway. Hundreds of Sordland and USP flags began to wave as the cheers intensified.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Without further ado, I invite the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Without further ado, I invite the President of Sordland to the stage.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Citizens! Welcome to the opening c..."
entries.dialogueText: “Citizens! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”
entries.menuText: “Citizens! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Lachaveners! Welcome to the openin..."
entries.dialogueText: “Lachaveners! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”
entries.menuText: “Lachaveners! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I walked to the podium to address t..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked to the podium to address the crowd. Cameras flashed around me.
entries.menuText: Walk up to the podium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The chanting from the crowd intensi..."
entries.dialogueText: The chanting from the crowd intensified. Some were yelling the motto of Lachaven: Liberty until eternity.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The chanting from the crowd continu..."
entries.dialogueText: The chanting from the crowd continued.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“At the beginning of this journey,..."
entries.dialogueText: “At the beginning of this journey, we promised jobs and opportunity. We kept our promise.”
entries.menuText: “At the beginning of this journey, we promised jobs and opportunity. We kept our promise.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Trust me, our work is far from ove..."
entries.dialogueText: “Trust me, our work is far from over. This project is only the beginning.”
entries.menuText: “Trust me, our work is far from over. This project is only the beginning.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The aim with the H-3 was to create..."
entries.dialogueText: “The aim with the H-3 was to create economic growth in East Nargis and Agnland.”
entries.menuText: “The aim with the H-3 was to create economic growth in East Nargis and Agnland.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Our intention with the H-3 was to..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our intention with the H-3 was to ensure citizens an easier commute between Lachaven and Arvory.”
entries.menuText: “Our intention with the H-3 was to ensure citizens an easier commute between Lachaven and Arvory.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as we left, the highway ope..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as we left, the highway opened to the public and thousands began using it.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“None of this would be possible wit..."
entries.dialogueText: “None of this would be possible without the sound advice of my Interior Minister Lileas Graf. Please come over here.”
entries.menuText: “None of this would be possible without the sound advice of my Interior Minister Lileas Graf. Please come over here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I must thank the brilliant mind be..."
entries.dialogueText: “I must thank the brilliant mind behind the highway project, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”
entries.menuText: “I must thank the brilliant mind behind the highway project, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“After we cut that ribbon and you d..."
entries.dialogueText: “After we cut that ribbon and you drive on the highway, you can judge our success for yourself.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“United we stand and divided we fal..."
entries.dialogueText: “United we stand and divided we fall.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Ensuring the success of this proje..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ensuring the success of this project wasn't just one of my presidential goals. I made it my personal priority."
entries.menuText: “Ensuring the success of this project wasn't just one of my presidential goals. I made it my personal priority."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas walked up to me and leaned i..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas walked up to me and leaned into the microphone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Symon walked up to me."
entries.dialogueText: Symon walked up to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I cut the ribbon, triggering cheers..."
entries.dialogueText: I cut the ribbon, triggering cheers from the crowd.
entries.menuText: Cut the ribbon.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Congratulations to all. Hopefully..."
entries.dialogueText: “Congratulations to all. Hopefully this is one of many successes to come."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“It's a good moment indeed. It give..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's a good moment indeed. It gives us pride as a nation. One big step forward."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Your car is ready.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Your car is ready.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A 40-meter-long red ribbon stretche..."
entries.dialogueText: A 40-meter-long red ribbon stretched across it.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This highway has brought and will..."
entries.dialogueText: “This highway has brought and will continue to bring thousands of new jobs."
entries.menuText: “This highway has brought and will continue to bring thousands of new jobs."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thanks to this highway, travel bet..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thanks to this highway, travel between Lachaven and Arvory is twice as fast and infinitely more comfortable."
entries.menuText: “Thanks to this highway, travel between Lachaven and Arvory is twice as fast and infinitely more comfortable."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I entered the car and sat in the dr..."
entries.dialogueText: I entered the car and sat in the driver's seat. The crowd was trying to catch a glimpse of me through the window.
entries.menuText: Enter the car.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'd like Lileas with me.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'd like Lileas with me.”
entries.menuText: “I'd like Lileas with me.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will drive the car on my own.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I will drive the car on my own.”
entries.menuText: “I will drive the car on my own.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I'm honored. It will be lovely to..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm honored. It will be lovely to arrive in Arvory with the President of Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I want to have Symon in the lead c..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want to have Symon in the lead car.”
entries.menuText: “I want to have Symon in the lead car.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Who do you want to travel with, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Who do you want to travel with, Mr. President?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Lucian, come ride with me.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Lucian, come ride with me.”
entries.menuText: “Lucian, come ride with me.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“This isn't necessary, but I won't..."
entries.dialogueText: “This isn't necessary, but I won't refuse. We can talk about future economic projects.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“As you wish. I'll see you in Arvor..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you wish. I'll see you in Arvory.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I revved the engine. Lucian waved a..."
entries.dialogueText: I revved the engine. Lucian waved at the press photographers as I drove us onto the new highway.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I revved the engine. Symon smiled a..."
entries.dialogueText: I revved the engine. Symon smiled awkwardly at the press photographers as I drove us onto the new highway.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I revved the engine. Lileas waved t..."
entries.dialogueText: I revved the engine. Lileas waved to the press photographers as I drove us onto the new highway.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I revved the engine and waved to th..."
entries.dialogueText: I revved the engine and waved to the press photographers as I drove onto the new highway.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The new highway was in pristine con..."
entries.dialogueText: The new highway was in pristine condition. The ride to Arvory was the smoothest I'd ever had.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After an uneventful four hours, we..."
entries.dialogueText: After an uneventful four hours, we were welcomed by a throng of Arvory citizens and Mayor Eric Niel.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“On another note. It goes without m..."
entries.dialogueText: “On another note. It goes without mentioning that this was a team effort.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I think all of us are.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I think all of us are.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Agreed. Every single press outlet..."
entries.dialogueText: “Agreed. Every single press outlet has of course been notified and they will be there.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Things were certainly easier back..."
entries.dialogueText: “Things were certainly easier back then.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Beginning with the President who p..."
entries.dialogueText: “Beginning with the President who put his trust in me, I want to thank everyone involved in the H-3.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Symon, you deserve the credit. Aft..."
entries.dialogueText: “Symon, you deserve the credit. After all, it was you who came up with the project.”
entries.menuText: “Symon, you deserve the credit. After all, it was you who came up with the project.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you for your kind words. It..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for your kind words. It truly means a good deal.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you for your kind words. It truly means a good deal.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“The people have been waiting a lon..."
entries.dialogueText: “The people have been waiting a long time for this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas continued to speak about the..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas continued to speak about the strength that comes from unity and the positive change the highway would bring to Agnland.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Symon continued to speak about how..."
entries.dialogueText: Symon continued to speak about how this project was a stepping stone towards a Sordish economic recovery.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd began cheering my name."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd began cheering my name.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The weather was warm and unusually..."
entries.dialogueText: The weather was warm and unusually calm for the windy port city. Spirits were high.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Despite Lachaven's strong PFJP pres..."
entries.dialogueText: Despite Lachaven's strong PFJP presence, a huge crowd of supporters had turned out. Lucian must have brought in some ringers.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I welcome you Lachaveners today as..."
entries.dialogueText: “I welcome you Lachaveners today as a proud servant of this country.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“This project is a perfect example..."
entries.dialogueText: “This project is a perfect example of the capacity and capabilities of Sordland as a nation.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Our aim with this project was obvi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our aim with this project was obvious: to improve the speed and efficiency of transportation.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Symon handed me a pair of oversized..."
entries.dialogueText: Symon handed me a pair of oversized scissors.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The drive to Arvory should take ab..."
entries.dialogueText: “The drive to Arvory should take about four hours. We'll be right behind you in the motorcade.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian stood up."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian stood up.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“First of all...”"
entries.dialogueText: “First of all...”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“This day may have arrived later th..."
entries.dialogueText: “This day may have arrived later than expected, but it doesn't change the fact that we are here now.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We couldn't have done this without..."
entries.dialogueText: “We couldn't have done this without our excellent team.”
entries.menuText: “We couldn't have done this without our excellent team.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I silently nodded."
entries.dialogueText: I silently nodded.
entries.menuText: Nod.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“To many more projects like this.”"
entries.dialogueText: “To many more projects like this.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I have a plan for how to do that.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I have a plan for how to do that.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good work.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good work.”
entries.menuText: “Good work.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Indeed.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Indeed.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It's been a long time since the la..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's been a long time since the last successful infrastructure project. From a public relations viewpoint, we can certainly capitalize on the occasion.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Let's move on to our plans for the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's move on to our plans for the opening tomorrow.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Well done.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Well done.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The president himself shall make t..."
entries.dialogueText: “The president himself shall make the maiden voyage from Lachaven to Arvory along with his motorcade. If he agrees, of course."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“What are your thoughts?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What are your thoughts?”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I think so too. Mr. President?”"
entries.dialogueText: “I think so too. Mr. President?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I guess we can't avoid that.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I guess we can't avoid that.”
entries.menuText: “I guess we can't avoid that.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We will need to show our best face..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will need to show our best face tomorrow. I'll make sure that our focus on improving business and logistics is relayed by whatever means necessary.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“See you at the ceremony.”"
entries.dialogueText: “See you at the ceremony.”
entries.menuText: “See you at the ceremony.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Goodbye for now.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Goodbye for now.”
entries.menuText: “Goodbye for now.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Once again, good work everyone.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Once again, good work everyone.”
entries.menuText: “Once again, good work everyone.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After he was done with his speech,..."
entries.dialogueText: After he was done with his speech, Lucian took Symon's place on the stage to close the ceremony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian took my place on the stage t..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian took my place on the stage to close the ceremony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After she was done with her speech,..."
entries.dialogueText: After she was done with her speech, Lucian took Lileas's place on the stage to close the ceremony.

entries.dialogueText: “Citizens of Lachaven! There you have it!”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“As promised, Anton Rayne -- the 4t..."
entries.dialogueText: “As promised, Anton Rayne -- the 4th President of Sordland -- has delivered!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We walked towards the entrance of t..."
entries.dialogueText: We walked towards the entrance of the highway next to the stage.
